qs.q: Identify the part of speech of the underlined word in: 'She is a beautiful girl.'
Which of the following describes the function of a conjunction?
o: It connects words, phrases or clauses

qs.q: Which tense form is used to present an activity as ongoing or temporary?

o: It remains in the present form
It moves to a corresponding past form

qs.q: What is the primary role of an adverb in a sentence?
o: To modify a verb, adjective, or another adverb

qs.q: What does 'Tense consistency' imply in English grammar?
o: Avoiding the use of subordinate clauses
Changing tense mechanically in every sentence
Choosing verb forms whose time relationships agree across clauses

qs.q: Which tense form relates an earlier situation to a later reference point?
Why must pronouns refer clearly to an antecedent?
o: To change the tense of the sentence

qs.q: When is a shift in tense justified in a sentence?
o: When the time frame or meaning changes
When the speaker wants to confuse the listener
When the sentence is too long

qs.q: What is the role of auxiliary verbs in a sentence?
o: To build tense, aspect, voice or modality
